author: Camemes
body:
So a while back, I received some invalid punishments for Ban evasion (2) and false reporting (1)

Ban evasion: https://avicus.net/punishments/110243
This is invalid as corey (know know as MyNameIsVinh) is actually my brother, yes it was appealed but I was wondering if it could be removed entirely.

Ban evasion: https://avicus.net/punishments/118444
Refer to the above explanation.

False reporting: https://avicus.net/punishments/607813
This is invalid as it was 3v2 situation, the player joined the team of 3 making it 4v2, I reported him for team stacking, he then switched teams to make it 3v3 and I get warned. I have no evidence of this.
